reviewed_coverage_statement: Covers reviewed atomic conditions for education paths (1)-(9), including path (9) candidate bases, school recognition, Science Tokyo early-entry requirements, and the shared individual-review procedure supported by the fixed official PDF.
limitation_statement: Uses exactly one academic credential and never treats applicant claims as school approval. External-university equivalence and final individual review remain official decisions. It does not cover paths (10)-(11), general application dates, language scores, complete materials, program scope, overall eligibility, admission, or recommendations.
